One historical reference is Alakh Alakhshah, a legendary king in Hindu mythology who was said to rule over the invisible realm of the universe. He is believed to have appeared during the Mahabharata period, which dates from around 400 BCE to 300 CE.

Another reference to the name Alakesh is Alakh Nand, a ruler of the Karnata Chalukya Empire in India during the 12th century CE. He is known for his military conquests and patronage of art and culture.
